newsitem.title: Australia: Current Australian Takeovers (A to E) - Aug 26.
newsitem.headline: Current Australian Takeovers (A to E) - Aug 26.

text.p: TERMS: A$4.64 cash per ordinary share, A$4.66 per
Ampolex preference share and A$7.00 per convertible note (closed May 10).
NOTES: Mobil is entitled to 99.39 percent of Ampolex
ordinary capital, 99.84 percent of preference capital and 54.9 percent of convertible note capital.
TERMS: A$2.40 cash per share and shareholders are
entitled to a fully franked special dividend of 7 cents per share.
NOTES: Azon advise shareholders to accept the offer in
the absence of any higher offer being received. Offeror is now entitled to 64.97 percent of the offeree.
TERMS: A$2.45 cash per share, raised from A$2.40 a share
NOTES: Offeror proposes to acquire 50 percent of each

shareholder's holding. Offeror is entitled to 15.76 percent of issued capital. On August 13 directors advised that shareholders voted against the resolution for the partial takeover offer, therefore the offer cannot proceed.
TERMS: One Darowa share for every two Caxton shares
NOTES: Offer conditional on 90 percent acceptance from
three quarters of the offerees. Directors advise shareholders take no action pending further advice. Offeror is now entitled to about 70.43 percent of the offeree.
TERMS: One EDI share plus 90 cents cash for every two
NOTES: EDI is now entitled to 91.1 percent of
Clyde. On July 15, Clyde directors recommended shareholders to accept the offer.
NOTES: Directors advise shareholders take no action
pending further advice. Offeror currently has 42.42 percent of the offeree.
RGC said on August 9 that the offer had closed with RGC holding about 76.7 percent of Cudgen's shares. RGC will not proceed to compulsory acquisition.
TERMS: 10 Futuris shares for every nine Elders shares
plus 23 cents for every Elders share.
NOTES: Elders directors said they intend to recommend
acceptance of the bid in the absence of a higher offer. Offeror is entitled to about 42 percent of the issued capital of Elders.
